name: Neyali, Suns' Vanguard
oracle_text:
Attacking tokens you control have double strike.
Whenever one or more tokens you control attack a player, exile the top card of your library. During any turn you attacked with a token, you may play that card.
blocked_sentences: During any turn you attacked with a token, you may play that card.

needs.what: a playable_condition value "you_attacked_with_a_token" for exile/grant_playable permissions: the permission holder declared as an attacker, this turn, a creature that is a token (read off TurnLedger.creatures_attacked like the commander variant, counting a token that attacked and has since left)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: PLAYABLE_CONDITIONS in engine/objects.py holds only "you_attacked_with_a_commander" (Neriv); playable: "while_exiled" alone would let the card be played on turns with no token attack, and playable_this_turn would wrongly expire it after this turn. The other two sentences are expressible (grant_keyword static over {controller: you, is_token: true, attacking: true}; creatures_attack_player trigger filtered is_token with an exile of the top card)
